title: Way2Pay
tagline: Payment platform integrating non-custodial multi-chain cryptocurrency payments in E-Commerce
description:
Way2Pay leverages cross-chain protocols and cutting-edge blockchain security features to provide a user-friendly, highly customizable payment platform, specifically designed for seamlessly integrating cryptocurrency transactions into the world of e-commerce.

Our solution empowers customers with the convenience of effortlessly using cryptocurrency as a payment option during their online shopping journey. No more navigating complex wallet setups or worrying about which blockchain their digital assets are on. With Way2Pay, their payments are effortlessly processed, regardless of the blockchain they choose.

Merchants benefit from the versatility of accepting any cryptocurrency from any blockchain, eliminating the need for managing multiple wallets across different chains. Moreover, we pride ourselves on our non-custodial services, ensuring the security and control of digital assets remain firmly in the hands of our users.

For business owners, Way2Pay offers a straightforward, yet highly adaptable dashboard. This tool allows them to easily monitor and manage their accounts, enabling them to stay in the loop and up-to-date with their cryptocurrency income stream.
how_its_made:
Our focus is on creating a seamless account registration process, establishing payment connections, and managing a dashboard. We employ a hybrid model that blends web3 and web2 components. The dashboard offers distinct flows for sellers and users, acting as a centralized hub for aggregating transaction data across the entire protocol.

On the web2 side, we use Next.js for the front-end, a REST API, and a MongoDB database, pivotal for ensuring a smooth and secure payment gateway experience.

In the web3 realm, we provide essential blockchain infrastructure for payment processing and reliable data sourcing. Our system supports cross-chain capabilities for interoperability between different blockchain networks, offering a developer-friendly API. We've also integrated a chat and notifications feature using the Push Protocol, enabling post-transaction interactions between users and sellers. Sellers can create badges for offering payment discounts, focusing on privacy through Zero-Knowledge proofs with Sismo Privacy Connect.

Integrating our payment system into external websites is straightforward and secure, requiring only an authenticated API call to our backend, ensuring a seamless payment process for external platforms.
